contract_data.basis: 68 of 97 rigs carry source/source_url/confidence fields; remaining 29 rigs are unsourced legacy entries.
contract_data.notes: Source coverage is strongest for Transocean, Hanwha Drilling, Odfjell Drilling, Dolphin Drilling, Stena Drilling, Vantage Drilling, Valaris drillships, Seadrill and selected Noble rigs. Valaris and Borr jack-up rows are the main remaining gap.

dayrates.basis: FSR-verified where source_url exists; otherwise indicative legacy value. Implied values are marked separately and should not be treated as disclosed dayrates.
dayrates.notes: Use rig-level confidence and day_rate_basis before treating a day_rate_kusd value as verified. Unsourced jack-up rates should not be used as contract observations.

rig_specs.basis: Company fleet status reports and public rig specification sheets where available.
rig_specs.notes: Rig specs may describe design capability rather than current contractual operating conditions.
